# operations.asset_daily_kpis

<!-- Generated by dctl from the contract. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Columns

| Column | Type | Required | Classification | Checks | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset_id` (key) | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^AST-[0-9]{6}$` | Business key of the production asset. |
| `site_code` | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2}$` | Code of the site that operates the asset. |
| `kpi_date` (key) | `DATE` | yes | internal |  | Calendar day the KPIs refer to, in the site time zone. |
| `planned_runtime_min` | `INT` | yes | internal | min 0; max 1440 | Minutes the asset was scheduled to run. |
| `run_time_min` | `INT` | yes | internal | min 0; max 1440 | Minutes the asset actually ran. |
| `units_produced` | `BIGINT` | yes | internal | min 0 | Units produced during the day, good and rejected. |
| `units_rejected` | `BIGINT` | yes | internal | min 0 | Units rejected by quality control. |
| `availability` | `DOUBLE` | yes | internal | min 0; max 1 | Run time divided by planned runtime. |
| `performance` | `DOUBLE` | yes | internal | min 0; max 1 | Actual output divided by theoretical output at nominal speed. |
| `quality_rate` | `DOUBLE` | yes | internal | min 0; max 1 | Good units divided by units produced. |
| `oee` | `DOUBLE` | yes | internal | min 0; max 1 | Availability times performance times quality rate. |
| `updated_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | yes | internal |  | When the row was last written by the gold pipeline, in UTC. |
